themes_negative: all visible reviews 5-star with very similar wording (possible review-bias pattern)

A separate similarly-named school 'Autorijschool Rob' (Future Traffic, instructor Andre) was found in search results and its reviews were deliberately NOT used to avoid misattribution.
review_summary: Aggregate signals are consistently positive (Google 5.0/24, Trustoo 9.2/26) and a secondary aggregator paraphrases recurring themes of calm, patient, clear instruction and passing first time, plus faalangst support; however, no verbatim individual reviews for this specific school could be read or captured, so no quote-level evidence is available and trust is insufficient.
